name: Two Lifts, One Beam
hint: Four takes, and the order cannot be changed, because everything you need is above you. Lift E1 (deck x=9..13) climbs from y=19.4 to y=13.2 at 1.6 u/s while plate p1 (x=4.5..6.7, on the floor) is held. The mid ledge at y=12.6 is 7.4 units above the floor, so E1 is the only way up. On that ledge, in order left to right: plate p2 (x=16..18.2) which opens the exit door d1, laser l1 at x=20 burning 1.4s and dark 1.6s, plate p3 (x=22.5..24.7) which powers lift E2 (deck x=28..32) climbing from y=12.0 to y=5.8 at 1.6 u/s. The exit ledge at y=6.0 is 6.6 units above the mid ledge, so E2 is the only way up again, and the exit at x=36.5 is sealed behind d1 with a bulkhead to the top of the world above it. TAKE 1: run right and STOP on p1; E1 rises behind you and parks at the top. End the take on the plate. TAKE 2: Echo A holds p1 from about t=0.3s. Run right to x=8.2 and hop onto E1's deck at about t=1.1s, while it has only risen 1.3 units — board later than about t=2.0s and the deck is past your jump. Ride up, arriving y=13.2 at t=4.18s, then jump right from x=12.2 over the 1.0 gap and 0.6 up onto the ledge. Walk right and STOP on p2 at about t=5.1s; never go past x=19.4, the beam is at x=20. End the take there. TAKE 3: Echoes A and B hold p1 and p2. Repeat the ride, land on the ledge at about t=4.55s, run to x=18.6 and WAIT — l1 is lit from t=5.0s to t=6.4s. Cross the moment it goes dark at t=6.4s; the 1.7 units past the beam take a quarter second and the dark window is 1.6s. Continue right and STOP on p3 at about t=6.9s. E2 rises empty. End the take there. TAKE 4: Echoes A, B and C hold all three plates and d1 is open. Ride E1, cross the beam at t=6.4s, then keep running right to x=25.2 (the ledge's right edge) and jump the 2.0 gap onto E2's deck at about t=7.2s — Echo C armed E2 at t=6.9s so the deck has only climbed 0.5 units and sits 1.2 above the ledge. You have roughly a second and a half before it is out of reach. Ride 6.2 units up, arriving y=5.8 at about t=10.7s, jump right from x=31.2 over the 1.0 gap onto the exit ledge (top y=6.0, a 0.2 drop), then through the open doorway at x=35 and into the exit at x=36.5, about t=11.5s. If you cross the beam early with a dash you will trip p3 yourself, E2 will start and then sink back when you step off, and you can simply wait aboard it until Echo C arrives.

dialogue.text: Two lifts. Two plates. And a light that keeps its own time.

dialogue.speaker: ECHO-0
dialogue.text: Three of us standing still so one of us can move.
I stopped asking which one I am.
